name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement a data re-uploading classifier
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement a data re-uploading classifier in PennyLane (single qubit, 6 layers of RZ(x)RY(w) blocks) to fit the function f(x)=cos(1 x) on [0, 2pi] with mean-squared-error training; report final loss. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
